summary.en: Cipla's development activity is generic- and respiratory-heavy, with much of the pipeline disclosed only in aggregate. Licensed oncology biologics add differentiated opportunities, but current company releases provide limited asset-level stage detail.
summary.zh: Cipla 的开发活动以仿制药和呼吸系统为主,管线大部分仅以汇总形式披露。授权引进的肿瘤生物药带来差异化机会,但公司目前发布的信息中单个资产层面的阶段细节有限。

ind.en: HER2-expressing cancers, including HER2-low advanced breast cancer
ind.zh: HER2 表达癌症,包括 HER2 低表达晚期乳腺癌

ind.en: Cancer; specific licensed indications not disclosed
ind.zh: 癌症;具体授权适应症未披露

watch.en: Cipla licensed TQB2102 for India, South Africa and five other emerging markets; the partner retains manufacturing and supply.
watch.zh: Cipla 获得 TQB2102 在印度、南非及其他五个新兴市场的授权;合作方保留生产和供应。

watch.en: Qilu handles development, registration and supply of QL2107; Cipla handles US commercialization.
watch.zh: Qilu 负责 QL2107 的开发、注册和供应;Cipla 负责美国商业化。

watch.en: Q2 FY27 R&D was INR423 crore, 5.7% of revenue; operating revenue was INR7,404 crore.
watch.zh: 2027 财年第二季度研发支出为 INR423 crore,占收入的 5.7%;营业收入为 INR7,404 crore。

watch.en: The September pipeline disclosure shows 46 ANDAs/NDAs under approval and 44 tentatively approved, rather than named clinical candidates.
watch.zh: 9 月的管线披露显示有 46 项 ANDA/NDA 审批中、44 项获暂时批准,而非已命名的临床候选药物。

sources: SBP TQB2102 licensing and global Phase 3 development, August 31, 2026
EMA CTIS QL2107-102: Phase 3 PK biosimilarity trial (indexed registry)
SBP TQB2102 China marketing application accepted, September 16, 2026
Cipla-issued QL2107 licensing release via PRNewswire, September 3, 2026
gaps: No full named innovative pipeline page was located; the complete current investor presentation was reviewed.
Only two individually named unapproved assets could be verified from reachable current company materials.
The Q2 transcript and press-release PDFs returned fetch errors, and the annual report timed out; the current Q2 presentation loaded successfully.
Regulatory totals refer to generic filings and are not company counts by clinical phase.

Both assets have Phase 3 programs in partner/global development. TQB2102 is filed in China, which is outside Cipla’s licensed territories; its phase here stays 3 rather than implying a Cipla-territory filing. QL2107-102 is a Phase 3 pharmacokinetic biosimilarity trial, not proof of a U.S. application.

No Cipla-territory next milestone/date was verified for either asset. QL2107 receptor-level target and specific licensed indications remain unverified; target is null. CTIS direct rendering was empty; indexed EMA registry text establishes phase.
